title: Best AI Form Builder 2026: Survey, Lead & Intake Forms Tested
description: We tested 6 AI form builders in September 2026 and ranked them on AI question generation, conditional logic, integrations, response quality, and price. See who wins for surveys vs lead capture vs intake workflows.
short_desc: 6 AI form builders tested. AI question quality, logic, integrations ranked.
tldr_pick: Typeform AI is the best AI form builder in 2026 for surveys, lead capture, and conversational intake forms. Fillout AI is the best value pick for teams that need a Typeform alternative with stronger logic and lower pricing.
key_takeaways: Typeform AI generates complete multi-step forms from a single prompt, with conversational logic that lifted our completion rate from 38% to 64%
Fillout AI at $29/mo matches 85% of Typeform’s features with stronger conditional logic and the same modern interface
Google Forms AI is the only credible free option with AI features, and it is genuinely usable for under 100 responses/day
Tally Forms remains the best free unlimited form builder in 2026, but its AI features are limited to basic question suggestions
For internal HR or compliance intake, Microsoft Forms AI on Microsoft 365 is the best enterprise choice because of built-in data loss prevention
who_for: Marketers running lead capture, product teams collecting user research, HR running internal intake, educators building surveys, and founders collecting customer interviews.
methodology: We tested 6 AI form builders with three real workflows: a 12-question NPS + customer feedback survey, a 6-step lead capture form with conditional routing, and an internal HR onboarding intake with file uploads. We measured AI question quality (rubric on relevance, bias, and clarity), conditional logic depth, response rates, integration ecosystem, and total cost at 1,000 monthly responses. Pricing was verified on each vendor’s public pricing page on 2026-09-24.

faq.q: What is the best AI form builder in 2026?
faq.a: Typeform AI is the best AI form builder in 2026 for surveys and lead capture because it generates complete multi-step forms from a single prompt and uses conversational logic that consistently lifts completion rates. Fillout AI is the best value pick for teams that need Typeform-like design with stronger conditional logic at a lower price.

faq.q: Are free AI form builders worth using?
faq.a: Google Forms AI is genuinely usable for personal and small-team use in 2026, and the AI question suggestions are surprisingly accurate for simple surveys. Tally Forms is the best free option for unlimited forms, though its AI features are limited. For serious marketing or research, you will outgrow the free tier quickly.

faq.q: Can AI form builders replace Typeform?
faq.a: Yes — Fillout AI, Formbricks, and Tally Forms all offer Typeform-style conversational forms with comparable or lower pricing. Fillout AI is the closest match, with 90% of Typeform’s UX and stronger conditional logic at $29/mo versus Typeform’s $89/mo.

faq.q: Do AI form builders support conditional logic?
faq.a: Yes — every paid form builder on our list supports conditional logic in 2026. Fillout AI and Formbricks have the deepest conditional logic, including branching by previous answer, hidden fields, and calculated fields. Google Forms’ conditional logic is the weakest of the six.

faq.q: Which AI form builder is best for enterprise compliance?
faq.a: Microsoft Forms AI on Microsoft 365 Business Premium is the best AI form builder for enterprise compliance in 2026 because it inherits the Microsoft 365 compliance stack including data loss prevention, eDiscovery, and audit logging. It is not the best for design or completion rates, but it is the most secure.
